mcp.description: Read the recorded Dragon Heist game table. Game moves require the configured Runner credential and an admitted Check in the bound Plan tree; this extension never qualifies TRUST Checks.

commands.name: game.create
commands.description: Create one game bound to an existing Dragon Heist root Plan. Repeating the same identity preserves recorded play.

commands.name: game.read
commands.description: Read one game or list up to 30 recently changed games. Recorded game completion is separate from TRUST Plan qualification.

commands.name: game.move
commands.description: Execute the one named external game move authorized by the current admitted Check. Only the configured Runner credential may act; recorded dice never reroll on retry.
